reviews.text: This restaurant really left a lasting impression on me. Let's start with the food. The signature steak was grilled to perfection, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, and the asparagus that came with it was very fresh. The lobster bisque was rich and full of flavor, and the bread was freshly baked, warm and fragrant. The service was also great. The waiters were very professional, food was served at a reasonable speed and plates were changed quickly. The atmosphere, with soft lighting and moderate music, was perfect for a date. However, the only disappointing thing is that the tiramisu dessert was a little sweet. The price is not cheap, but I think it is reasonable considering the quality of the ingredients and the overall experience. Next time, I definitely want to try other menu items with my friends. Overall, it was a very satisfying dining experience.

reviews.text: Out of Time, located near Seongsu Station, is a hidden gem cocktail bar. The professional and friendly bartenders speak fluent English, recommend drinks and provide friendly explanations. The combination of soft lighting and soft music creates a warm and comfortable atmosphere, making it the perfect place for conversation. The cocktails are great, but the seasonal menu, Bungeopang, is especially impressive. Custom cocktails can also be ordered. There are many different types of whiskey, so even people who don't enjoy drinking whiskey will be able to find something to suit their taste. The owner is warm and kind and tells stories about the whiskey making process. You can enjoy it without burden at a reasonable price of 20,000 to 40,000 won per person. Perfect for both a date or a casual gathering with friends, this is definitely a place you'll want to return to.

reviews.author: Yong Eui Choi
reviews.text:
I visited Amore Cosmetics after reading an article that it had opened a flagship store in Seongsu-dong, which is emerging as a hot place these days. It is located about a block from the main street into a small alley, between a waste material storage yard and small factories, and there is no parking lot. An exhibition hall using an existing building is wrapped low in a 'ㄷ' shape, centered around a courtyard that seems to preserve nature with a shallow ditch, rocks, and trees. As if reflecting the latest trends, an effort was made to preserve the old atmosphere by renovating the existing building with minimal construction without much modification.

When you enter the entrance, you are greeted by guides who help you sign up. It is said that if you make a reservation in advance and visit, you can participate in a makeup instruction class. So, there is a separate space inside for washing your face. You can take a look at the products and listen to the guide's explanations as you walk through the exhibition contents in a long hallway. You can only get detailed information and experience it here, but you cannot purchase it. By creating large front windows facing the courtyard in all spaces, we took care to ensure that the natural scenery can be seen from inside as well.

If you go up to the second floor, there is a space where you can enjoy Osulloc tea. You can drink tea at a 20% discount using the discount coupon issued at the first floor entrance. There is a clean restroom here, and stairs lead up to the rooftop. It's not a place to enjoy the view, but there are chairs and tables available, so it's worth going up to the rooftop if it's a good season.

It is a recent example of considerable success in terms of experiential marketing and space marketing. The efforts of companies to attract customers both online and offline are truly remarkable. From the entrance, check whether or not you have signed up for the website and naturally encourage online communication. The homepage is designed to fit the smartphone screen, so it does not look awkward on mobile SNS.

reviews.author: Semi Park (Mumin)
reviews.text: They say it was built by remodeling an old auto repair shop, so if you like cosmetics or are interested in makeup, it's a great place where you can hang out all day. You can find all kinds of cosmetics from Amore, from cleansing to basics, color tones, and professional makeup services, right on the spot. For lip alone, hundreds of color tones are categorized in detail, so you can really try everything. You can freely choose a product, sit at the vanity table, and play with makeup. There is Osulloc Café upstairs, where you can get drinks at a discounted price.
